title: Dock conflict report misses long unloads
text: The Kent cross-dock had two trucks sitting at door D4 on Tuesday, and the conflict report hadn't flagged it. A Hartline floor-load unload (A) was booked 08:00-12:00, followed by appointments B at 09:00-09:30 and C at 10:00-10:30. The report listed only (A, B). It should list (A, B) and (A, C), since the long unload still holds the door at 10:00. The check is `find_conflicts` in `dock_schedule.py`.
